posts.title: Creating Custom Bluesky Feeds is Weirdly Hard
posts.description: Having been on Bluesky fairly casually for a while now, I largely just use the home feed which I mostly keep to Pokemon and a secondary feed that was a list of Nerdfighters. But for October's NerdfArter drawings one of my dear friends from Nerdfighteria requested a custom feed to compile the posts to easily follow the tag without needing to click through to the tag search each time they wanted to
